highlights: Shipped 20+ features and fixes per sprint cycle, including critical bugs, helping reduce production incidents and making delivery cycles up to 30% faster.
Built components for a new public-facing platform, with up to 20% higher conversion and a better browsing experience.
Created an internal admin system that centralizes operations, with 15% less time spent on manual tasks and fewer direct database changes.
Implemented CDN and caching strategies on the backend and frontend, with up to 20% faster load times and better scalability for the video platform.
Integrated AI agents into the development cycle, automating PR analysis and code review, with up to 10% less effort on code integration.
Led a squad of 2 full-stack developers, assigning tasks, tracking deliveries and removing blockers.
Ran sprint planning and continuous improvement of the development process, keeping the team aligned with project and company goals.
Coordinated the development and maintenance of the company's systems, ensuring operational continuity and the evolution of its solutions.
Designed, architected and built a complete ERP system for the company's clients.
Migrated legacy systems to AWS, using EC2 and RDS to scale the operation.
Implemented report generation queues run by cron jobs outside business hours, reducing system load and enabling on-demand generation.
Built credit analysis, contract delivery and digital authentication modules.
Added file upload features and PDF and Excel report exports.
Built the Svelte frontend on top of a Node.js API that I also developed.
Used Puppeteer to scrape real estate data from Brazil's main regions.
Consolidated the data into reports for analysis and comparison.

objective.p1: I'm looking for challenges where I can design and deliver scalable, efficient solutions, combining full-stack development, system architecture and cloud.
objective.p2: I value teams that care about code quality, frequent delivery and continuous learning, and I like contributing to processes, reviews and good practices.
objective.p3: I'm interested in products with real impact on users, where performance, browsing experience and business results go hand in hand.
objective.p4: I want to keep growing as an engineer and as a technical leader, exploring AI applied to software development and helping the team reach its goals.
